charts.title: pi Men c: orbits around HD 39091
charts.description: The orbits of HD 39091's planets in this map from above, to scale, with pi Men c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kunovac Hodžić et al. 2021 (2021MNRAS.502.2893K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KUNOVAC_HODZIC_ET_AL_2021): P 6.2678399 d
